'''2013 Match Play Championship Day 1 Josh Mack DS Kessel''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Josh Mack]] at [[2013 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Kessel (Dark)|Kessel]]
* '''Username:''' Remaker
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
